rv.q: With her trusty spray tan gun and celebrity impersonations, Nicole Travolta’s confessional comedy show is doing pretty well.

In Nicole Travolta Alright, actor and comedienne Nicole Travolta does exactly that, crafting a fast-moving, brutally honest solo show that leans into her chaos with humor, candor, and surprising control.

cn.t: Nicole Travolta turns personal chaos into compelling comedy in this fast-moving solo show. Critics praise her honest, controlled performance that proves she's more than just a famous last name.
